entities.summary: Dmitry Dmitriyevich Borisov is a Russian journalist, TV host on Channel One Russia, a Runet activist, producer of documentary projects and chief executive producer of Channel One Russia Worldwide. He has won a TEFI award as the best TV news presenter.
